passiveBonuses.desc: All technologies are researched for free but take significantly longer. Each Scholar garrisoned in a Mosque reduces research time by 25%.
Scholars garrisoned in Mosques grant +25% research speed each, up to a maximum of 4 Scholars per Mosque.

age2.bonus: Produces Scholars at half the normal cost. Each Scholar trained here arrives already garrisoned in the nearest Mosque.
Nearby military units gain +15% attack speed after winning a battle. Buff lasts 30 seconds.

age3.bonus: All defensive structures gain +50% HP and fire arrows 25% faster. Acts as a Garrison for 10 units.
Research speed is doubled globally. Unique technologies only available at this landmark unlock advanced elephant upgrades.

age4.bonus: Periodically spawns a free War Elephant or Tower War Elephant. Elephant units produced 30% faster.
All buildings (including economic structures) passively generate food over time based on type.

uniqueUnits.special: Tramples nearby infantry on charge, dealing area damage. Towers can be mounted for ranged defense.
Carries a tower with 4 garrisoned archer slots, firing arrows while moving. Crushes siege equipment on contact.
Non-combatant. Garrisoning in a Mosque reduces all research time by 25%. Can heal nearby units.

uniqueTech.effect: Elephant units gain +20% movement speed. Free technology, takes 180 seconds base research time.
War Elephants and Tower War Elephants gain +200 HP and +3 armor. Free technology, takes 300 seconds base.
Mosques can garrison 2 additional Scholars each. Free technology, takes 90 seconds base research time.
